skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn my photos into a smooth video with transitions — and get animated vid...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Image to Video Gratis:

- Instantly convert uploaded images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) into animated video clips with AI—no editing software required.
- Free, cloud-based processing with automatic session and token management (100 free credits, quick 30–60s export).
- Handles core video tasks: smooth transitions, export to 1080p MP4, add text or audio, preview timeline, and manage credits—all via simple chat prompts.
- Designed for seamless uploading and guided workflows, with helpful error messages and status updates.
- Supports essential export and upload formats: mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac.
